description: Result returned after a file upload or chunk upload.

members.name: IsComplete
members.description: True when the asset is complete. Chunk uploads may return false before the final chunk.

members.name: UploadSessionId
members.description: Upload session id for chunked uploads, when needed.

members.name: Url
members.description: Download or preview URL, when immediately available.

members.name: SizeBytes
members.description: File size in bytes, when known.

members.name: ExpiresAt
members.description: URL expiration timestamp, when the provider returns short-lived URLs.

members.name: ErrorMessage
members.description: Error message when Success is false.
